Container.Name: Grand-Theft-Auto-Connected-Server
Container.Author: MightyRufo
Container.Overview:
Grand Theft Auto Connected dedicated server. Auto-fetches the latest official Linux build on every start, or pin a specific version with GTAC_VERSION. Edit /config/server.xml and /config/resources to customise the server.
[b][color=#e74c3c]FIRST-BOOT GOTCHA:[/color][/b] the stock upstream server.xml ships with [b]<game>gta:iii</game>[/b] (GTA III). If you're hosting [b]GTA IV[/b], you must edit /config/server.xml after the first boot and change [b]gta:iii[/b] to [b]gta:iv[/b] (and set [b]iv_episode[/b] / [b]iv_gamemode[/b] to suit) or any GTA IV client will be kicked with "UNSUPPORTED ENGINE". Restart the container after editing.
[b]Update model:[/b] restart the container to pull the newest server build. The container scrapes the official downloads page, compares against the locally installed version, and only re-downloads when there's something newer. Your /config (server.xml, resources, htdocs) is never touched after the first boot.
This is an unofficial community packaging of the GTA Connected dedicated server. Not affiliated with the GTAC project. See https://gtaconnected.com/ for the upstream.
Container.Changes: ### 0.1.0 (2026-05-13) - Initial release. - Auto-update from the upstream GTAC downloads page on every container start. - AMD64 + ARM64 (host-auto-detected). - /config seeded on first boot with stock server.xml + resources/.
Container.Description:
Grand Theft Auto Connected dedicated server. The container resolves the newest official Linux build on every start, or pin a specific build with GTAC_VERSION. Config (server.xml, resources, htdocs) lives in /config. Logs in /data. Ports 22000 TCP + UDP. Runs non-root as uid/gid 1000.
FIRST-BOOT GOTCHA: the stock upstream server.xml defaults to <game>gta:iii</game> (GTA III). If you're hosting GTA IV, edit /config/server.xml after the first boot and change gta:iii to gta:iv (and set iv_episode / iv_gamemode for your install) or any GTA IV client will be kicked with "UNSUPPORTED ENGINE". Restart the container after editing.

Config.Name: Game port (TCP)
Config.Description: Game traffic + built-in HTTP server. Must match <port> in server.xml.

Config.Name: Game port (UDP)
Config.Description: Game sync traffic. Must match <port> in server.xml.

Config.Name: Config volume
Config.Description: Holds server.xml, resources/, htdocs/. Edit these on the host then restart the container.

Config.Name: Pinned version
Config.Description: Pin a specific GTAC version (e.g. 1.7.3). Leave empty to auto-update to latest on every container restart.

Config.Name: Skip update check
Config.Description: Set to 1 to skip the update check at start (offline/air-gapped use). The container will reuse the already-extracted Server binary in /opt/gtac.

Config.Name: Architecture override
Config.Description: Force AMD64 or ARM64. Auto-detected from the host when empty.

Config.Name: Downloads URL
Config.Description: Override only if mirroring upstream. The trailing slash is required.
